checks: Eligibility admits only signed/unsigned machine integers, with at most one Optional wrapper; floating, Decimal, Interval and Null-only types remain on the ordered-fold path.
GetSumResultType widens eligible signed inputs to Int64 and unsigned inputs to Uint64, making the first value SafeCast exact.
AggrAdd and ordinary + share TAdd/SafeAdd; ordinary subtraction uses SafeSub. Interpreted integer arithmetic uses unsigned modulo operations and codegen uses add/sub without signed-overflow flags.
Inclusive endpoint prefix subtraction plus the first contribution agrees with a direct ordered fold in the 64-bit modular ring.
Private cumulative non-NULL counts distinguish all-NULL frames from numeric zero; optional prefix values are coalesced only for cancellation and the frame count restores NULL output.
BuildOutputRowType and BuildChainLambda use the same framePrefixSums/CanUsePrefixSum/optional-input guard. Auxiliary names use the existing collision-free temporary-name suffix.
BuildExpandFromStructs emits only OutputLayout fields, excluding auxiliary count fields from the public result.
WinFrame single-element mode returns frame.Max()-1 or Nothing, while normal queue range supports a fresh iterator for Head; both depend on the current frame row.
Whole/running/suffix paths retain default false flags and original fold behavior; mixed aggregate frames retain folded non-prefix aggregate state.
remaining_validation: Compile and type-annotate generated optional/required/narrow-input ASTs.
Run baseline/fixed semantics across ROWS/RANGE, empty/all-null frames, ordering directions, peer groups and mixed aggregate expressions.
Observe no reachable Fold/Fold1 for COUNT/integer-SUM-only general frames and measure frame-width scaling.
Validate interpreted and LLVM execution agree at signed/unsigned wrap boundaries.
scope_limit: This amendment covers COUNT and machine-integer SUM only. The original general-frame optimization finding remains partially open for floating/Decimal/Interval SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX.
